Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports route editing and supervised generation, sortable resources, farming priorities with scheduled reviews, flight, underwater and guided cave navigation, an Island route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Added a guided flight out of the initial cave before starting an outdoor route. If the corridor cannot be traversed, Stock Manager now falls back to Isle Return instead of repeatedly navigating into the cave wall.

Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Positional Cue
Description: Positional HUD and target ring with sound cues. Optional experimental Wrath ST/AoE combo-button forecast with current adjusted cast time and per-job hotbar bindings. Reborn and RSR supply direction-only positional hints. No movement or action execution. Settings: /pcue.
Punchline: Positional hints and an optional Wrath spell forecast.
Changelog: Experimental draggable ST/AoE forecast with Wrath threshold, current cast time and per-job bindings. Removed character movement functionality. Live game validation pending.

Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Emote Shelf
Description: Browse Penumbra emote mods, choose variants, and pin favorites to an icon panel. Supports ground-sit and standing-idle poses. Experimental pair launch includes required alignment and needs Lightless Sync with your partner. Technical error reports are mandatory after accepting the first-use notice; collection cannot be disabled while using the plugin. Open with /es or /eshelf. Solo playback requires only Penumbra.
Punchline: One-click bookmarks for Penumbra emote mods.
Changelog: 0.3.9.30: fix upward panel drift during startup auto-sizing. Calculate the icon grid size before drawing so loading icons does not shift the restored position. Geometry tests and build passed; restart-in-game validation remains required. Matching AGPL source included.

Author: CheesyChiz
Name: XIVGear Prog
Description: Connect your account using a revocable token. Sends your equipped gear and saved combat gear sets, including materia and relic stats, to xivgearprog.top. Includes gear in bags and Armoury Chest. Retainers are excluded. Open /xgp to connect; changes sync automatically.
Punchline: Sync equipped gear and saved gear sets with XIVGear Prog.
Changelog: Initial release: automatic gear, materia, relic stat and saved gear-set sync with XIVGear Prog using revocable account tokens. Includes inventory and Armoury Chest gear. Build and server integration tests passed; live in-game validation is pending.
